name: RAB Nyagatare Research Station (animal resources; Karama farm and Mirama feedlot)
category: RAB station (forage seed, fodder, hay, germplasm; improved goat genetics per PRISM)
location: Nyagatare District, Eastern Province (the report names 'Karama farm' and 'Mirama feedlot' as its sites; exact addresses not retrieved)
offerings: FY2019/20: 33 ha maintained for fodder, forage seed and germplasm; station-wide about 100.5 ha of forage across Rubona, Karama, Kinigi and Songa; at least 100,000 Napier cuttings and 956 kg of Chloris gayana, Panicum and Desmodium seed produced; 58 t of hay baled (Chloris gayana, Brachiaria) 'used to the RAB farms or sold to the private farmers'; PRISM (2022) lists the station as providing improved goat genetic material and fodder seed
prices_published: none found (no price for hay, seed, cuttings or animals)
verified: 2026-10-19: forage and hay activity confirmed in RAB annual reports for 2018/19 and 2019/20; goat genetics statement only in PRISM; no station page, stock list, price or contact found
notes: A listed station is not confirmed stock. RAB's 2019/20 report mentions no goat or sheep research. Nyagatare is an RVF-affected Eastern district; goat brucellosis (6.08% to 10.78% seroprevalence) and Haemonchus (71.8% of goats) are documented there (LVS-39, LVS-46). Where 'Karama farm' sits is unclear: RAB places Karama long-term trials in Bugesera district, but lists 'Karama farm' under the Nyagatare station.

name: RAB Gishwati Station (Merino sheep multiplication)
location: Gishwati, Western Province (district and address not stated in the article)
offerings: RAB imported 45 Merino ewes and 5 rams from Kenya under PRISM; flock multiplied to 143 in one year; farmers apply for the breed (80 applications, 60 approved) and are asked not to sell it on; Gishwati is also a forage seed plot site in 2018/19
verified: 2026-10-19: station activity read in one press article (2024-05-08); no station page, price or contact found
notes: Closest documented source of improved sheep for the Nyabihu zone. Approval is by RAB application; eligibility, price and health documents unknown. Merino is a wool/meat sheep; Rwanda's mutton demand is small (see market file).

name: RAB forage seed multiplication stations (Rubona, Songa, Kinigi/Musanze, Gishwati)
location: Rubona and Songa (Southern Province), Kinigi/Musanze (Northern), Gishwati (Western)
offerings: FY2018/19: 40.5 ha of new seed plots at Nyagatare, Songa, Gishwati, Musanze and Rubona; 500 kg Chloris and Panicum seed collected; species grown include Chloris gayana, Panicum maximum/coloratum, Cenchrus ciliaris, Brachiaria decumbens cv. Basilisk, Desmodium intortum, Macroptilium atropurpureum, Napier
verified: 2026-10-19: multiplication confirmed in RAB reports; whether seed is sold to private farms, at what price, in what quantity: not found
notes: RAB reports describe seed 'distributed to different farmers' for dairy cattle projects, not a retail seed shop.

name: RAB Karama Rural Resource Centre (RRC) and Bugesera satellite nurseries
category: RAB nursery (tree, fruit and fodder-tree seedlings)
location: Karama, Bugesera District; satellite nurseries in Juru, Rweru, Mareba, Musenyi and Nyamata sectors
offerings: Oct-Nov 2019: 249,922 tree and fruit seedlings produced and 224,073 distributed to 1,973 households; satellite nurseries distributed 20,734 Calliandra calothyrsus and 18,118 Gliricidia sepium seedlings plus Grevillea and fruit trees
verified: 2026-10-19: activity read in the RAB 2019/20 annual report; seedlings were distributed through projects to households, not confirmed as sold; no current price or contact found
notes: Fodder-tree sources (Calliandra, Gliricidia) inside the Bugesera candidate zone. The fruit-tree agent may hold more on the nursery.

name: SABAN Ltd (Saban Abattoir)
category: abattoir (slaughter service for cattle, goats, sheep)
location: Nyabugogo, Nyarugenge District, Kigali City
offerings: Slaughter service; supplies meat to butcheries, hotels, bars and restaurants across Kigali; cold rooms; at least 12 inspections on meat; its staff buy livestock at markets across the country before holidays
verified: 2026-10-19: operations described in news reports 2018-2026 and in PRISM; no official website, phone or email found
notes: Largest Kigali outlet for goats and sheep: about 150 goats and 40 sheep per day in 2019 (about x4 and x3 at year-end); nearly 600 goats and sheep on Christmas Eve and Christmas 2017 versus about 300 on normal days; four days without goats or sheep in July 2026 during the RVF quarantine. Traders own the carcasses; the abattoir only provides slaughter (PRISM).

name: Rugari Meat Processing Ltd (APTC) - Gako farm and abattoir
category: meat processor / commercial goat and cattle farm
location: Gako, Bugesera District (farm); outlets in Kigali, Rubavu and Rusizi
offerings: 2016: abattoir with sections for cattle and goats; over 500 cattle and 700 goats on the Gako farm (target 10,000 goats by 2018); supplied 20 hotels and restaurants through its outlets
certification: HACCP certification being pursued in 2016-17 (outcome unknown)
verified: 2026-10-19: facts from a 2016 press interview and PRISM (the Rubavu branch manager was interviewed in 2022); no current website, goat numbers or purchasing policy found
notes: Possible competitor and possible buyer or breeder source close to the Bugesera zone; unknown whether the goat herd still exists. Gako also hosts a beef PPP (LVS-08).
